tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieves the full published record for an entity returned by search (clinic, doctor, treatment, service or policy). Pass the value of the search result's `id` field — the parameter may be given as either `id` or `entity_id`.

tools.name: get_aftercare_information
tools.description: Returns the clinic's remote follow-up schedule and the process for handling a suspected problem after a patient has returned home.

tools.name: get_clinic_profile
tools.description: Returns structured facts about the Taki Dent clinic: legal identity, address, contact details, languages spoken, and published certifications/licences/registrations.

tools.name: get_doctor_profile
tools.description: Returns a clinician profile — title, specialty, languages, education, and published professional memberships — matched by entity_id, full name, or a known name-spelling alias.

tools.name: get_guarantee
tools.description: Returns the clinic's warranty terms, tiered by treatment material (implants, crowns, veneers, composite bonding), including exclusions and remote-claim process.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Returns the clinic's published treatment prices in GBP and EUR, per treatment and per full-mouth package.

tools.name: get_reviews_summary
tools.description: Returns the clinic's Google review count and average rating, sourced from the live Google Business Profile.

tools.name: get_treatments
tools.description: Lists treatments offered by the clinic, each with its canonical page URL.

tools.name: get_visit_information
tools.description: Returns practical trip-planning facts: clinic location, opening hours, airport distance, transfers, accommodation, expected stay length, and package inclusions.

tools.name: get_whatsapp_contact
tools.description: Returns the clinic's WhatsApp contact deep link, pre-filled with a consultation-request message in the requested language.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Requests a callback from the clinic's patient coordination team. Sends the provided name and contact details to the clinic (irreversible once sent). Collects only contact information; do not include medical details.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches the clinic, doctor, treatment, service and policy entity index by name, alias, or summary text. Queries work in English, Turkish, German, Arabic, Russian, French and Polish. Each result carries an `id` that can be passed directly to the `fetch` tool.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
